findings.issue: The new test-support widening ignores a declared entry that is the unscoped sweep. select() returns `widen` for any changed file under a test directory that no arm picked, whatever the task's gate holds, so affected_steps never reaches left_to_run and instead adds every phase-gate entry the task did not declare as `affected/phase-gate:` steps. With a gate of [selftests] (or [selftests, lint]) in the dogfood plan, a change to tests/_harness.py now pulls validate, plugin-validate, gate, report, shots, interactive and vitest into the task run, browser gates included. But the reason for this widening is that every suite may depend on the support file, and `selftests` (python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py, the spelling with {paths} removed) already runs every suite. This works against the description's 'counts as already wide for the Python arm' and the phase outcome that whole-tree scanners run once per phase. It costs time but is not a correctness gap: the widened run is a superset.
findings.resolution: Treat the test-support widen as satisfied when a declared entry is the derived spelling with `{paths}` removed. That is the same word comparison left_to_run makes. Either have select() report support as its own reason (e.g. `widenSuites`) that affected_steps checks against the declared entries before adding the phase gate, or make the check in affected_steps. Add a case: gate [selftests] with only tests/_harness.py changed adds no phase-gate step and says which key covers it. Keep the case where a narrow path-scoped gate with the same change still widens.

preExisting.issue: For a changed tests/_harness.py, the dogfood related listing gives the reason 'its own cases' but does not name tests/_harness.py itself. This is the selector half of the measured mutation miss at f6656f8ff (executor's finding i). The task gate now compensates through the test-support widen, but the measured selector still misses it, so a re-measurement would count it again.
preExisting.resolution: Have tools/affected.py's related listing name the harness's own run (or every suite) when a test-support file changes, and re-measure.

preExisting.issue: The paragraph says select walks five arms including meta.coupling, but ARMS holds four and af15 pins that coupling is not read (executor's finding ii). This is outside the lines this diff changed.
preExisting.resolution: Make the arm list in the guide match ARMS.
